# Дварфы
<<<<<<< HEAD Дворфы во многом похожи на людей, но лучше переносят алкоголь и исцеляются им. ======= ## General Information >>>>>>> wizards/stable
Dwarves are physically smaller than most other species, so they're slowed more when dragging objects and slow others less when dragged themselves.
Their hardy digestive systems are more resistant to the effects of alcohol, and they can even [color=lightgreen]heal minor injuries[/color] by drinking.
They tend to be fond of food, and can digest up to five reagents at once, where other species generally digest up to three.
